name: Soviet Gas Blaster #21
description:
A toy-like gas pistol from the Soviet Union, which releases an inexplicable fog when operated. Upon inhalation, the gas induces a state of mild drowsiness and confusion. The gas dissipates within 10 minutes.

EFFECT: Induces mild drowsiness and disorientation in targets within a 5-meter radius.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: The pistol emits a cloud of gas resembling fog when the trigger is pulled, causing drowsiness in those exposed.
TASTE: Not applicable.
PACKAGING: The item is a small, plastic toy-like pistol with a dull red and green color scheme. The body features a retro Soviet aesthetic with blocky, angular shapes. The words "Газовое Бластер" are printed in yellow Cyrillic letters on the side. The nozzle has a faint, green luminescence.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Manual suggests toy use but feels eerily purpose-driven. A joker in the Soviet arsenal?

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-16 — edition #21 of the permanent record.
